items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-09-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I wonder what ever happened to Rappi? [INTERVIEWEE] This woman right down on this street... She used to be a piano player in the nightclub.

ctx.x: Well they had a lot of them blues played around here for her on piano.
I wonder what ever happened to Rappi?

This woman right down on this street. What street we on? St. Peter? Yeah right down there. She used to be a piano player in the nightclub. Larry know her name good. You know who I'm talking about. She lived 10, 1010 I believe. St. Peter. Johnson I think. Yeah well she used to play in the nightclub.
